notes.title: Update Notice
notes.content:
【Update Contents】
Function content
1. Element appending
a) New function: element appending
b) Function entrance: Forge - Append
c) Elemental append can be applied to the Divinity equipment to increase the elemental attribute bonus of the equipment. Adding requires the consumption of add-on stone and elemental add-on stone.
d) Elemental appending has a probability of failure and downgrade, you can use elemental luck gems to avoid downgrade.
e) The specific rules are based on the game.
2. Ancient Band
a) The name of the function will be changed to: Divine Decoration.
b) The original art resources of the divine ring are optimized into the new divine decoration resources
c) New ancient divine ornaments
d) Divine Altar
i. You can equip uncombatted ornaments to the ornament altar to obtain attribute bonuses, which are affected by the star level of the ornament and the level of the altar
ii. The specific rules are based on in-game rules
3. Sacred Weapons
a) Optimize the art resources of sacred weapons
b) Divine Artifact Refining function
i. Circlet of Celestial quality can be refined
ii. refining can obtain attribute bonuses and set skills
iii. The specific rules are based on in-game rules
4. reward adjustment
a) Cross-Server Sanguine Contest: Increase activity rewards and fashion attributes
b) Ancient Treasury: increase the drop rewards
c) Demon Portal: increased rewards for playing
5. other
a) Juggernaut: support dismantling into pieces in the backpack
b) Holy Blade: interface sliding optimization
c) Soul cards: Optimize the sorting and switching of soul cards
6. embryo
Hope you have a great day
